minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Select Board held a public hearing under MGL c.140 §157 on a nuisance-dog complaint filed by George and Jennifer Burden against neighbors Charles and Stacy Cordmash. The complainant declined to testify, while the investigating detective, the animal control officer, the dog owner, and a neighboring HOA trustee all testified that they found no evidence of excessive barking or other nuisance behavior; after deliberation the board voted unanimously that the dog is not a nuisance dog, and town counsel was asked to draft the written decision and to consider changing the hearing process going forward.
